mission: Awaken and orient the survivors, extract the full truth about the wound and the technique, and determine the threat level of Veraine's confirmed awakening.
why_now: The stasis chamber occupants represent the only living witnesses to what created the wound. Awakening them is the only way to understand the crisis. Veraine's awakening is confirmed — the race begins.
conflict: Immediate danger of awakening, emotional devastation of survivors learning millennium has passed, full scope of the technique and wound revealed, Veraine's awakening confirmed
turning_point: Full scope revealed: the Reformations were penance, the technique created the wound, Veraine is awake and moving. Ben commits. Lock-in is complete.
setting: Gavran's fortress — stasis chamber and deep archive
emotional_trajectory: The cycle of institutional failure made visible. Ben chooses to reject it.
notes: Ben is locked in. Seal failing, Veraine active, survivors are the only ones who understand. Guarded contact with Luke. Ben commits.
